reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis invokes micro-galvanic cells and oxide disruption, which are plausible mechanisms, but the baseline comparison (single-phase wear or corrosion at room temperature) conflates temperature and synergy effects, making the mechanistic claim scientifically weak.
reasons.testability: The proposed test compares simultaneous wear+corrosion at 500°C against single-phase wear or corrosion at room temperature, which cannot isolate the synergistic mechanism from the effect of temperature alone, so the test would not decide the hypothesis.
reasons.usefulness: The core idea of synergy via galvanic cells and oxide disruption is relevant, but the flawed baseline and vague mechanism make it of little practical use for designing a discriminating experiment.
